messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [INC-2090123456] High GPU queue growth on pool 'high-priority-gpu' (>120s). Autoscaler attempted scale but multiple rejections. Paging on-call.
jen: I got this. Looking at cluster and autoscaler events.
lee: quick snippet from autoscaler: `scale_request: 6 gpus -> failed: quota_exceeded (region-gpu-limit)` and `node_attach: driver-init-timeout` repeated.
pat: node logs show repeated CUDA Xid errors and oom kills. Example from gpu-node-109:
```
[2026-05-03T18:12:02Z] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1b.0): 79, GPF in nvidia_uvm
[container] error: mmap failed: Cannot allocate memory
[kernel] Out of memory: Killed process 31415 (serve) total-vm: 12G
```
eng-runtime: We rolled a runtime change yesterday that increases KV cache retention for short-lived sessions; under heavy continuous batching this can push pinned memory up. Reproducing in staging.
jen: Mitigation plan (short-term):
- disable continuous batching for route 'high-priority'
- throttle non-SLA queues (batch/async) to 20% throughput
- route dev/dev-tier to cpu-fallback pool
- cordon nodes with recurring Xid errors and drain safe pods
- request emergency GPU quota increase with cloud partner (ops to own)
pat: cordoning gpu-node-109 and gpu-node-113 now. Will avoid evicting persistent sessions labeled `priority=gold`.
infra-shift: Opening emergency quota request: EQ-5412 to provider for +8 GPUs in us-central2. ETA unknown. Also sending escalation to partner rep.
jen: Applied config change: `feature.disable_continuous_batching=true` for production route at 2090123620. Deploy-bot: show rollout.
deploy-bot: Rollout started for config change 2090123620; 4/5 proxies acked, edge cache invalidated.
cs-bot: Notifying CS: Potential latency spikes and timeouts for dev/free tiers. Draft prepared.
lee: After cordon, OOM logs quieter on those nodes but queue remains high because autoscaler couldn't replace capacity. We can enable temporary CPU fallback routing for non-critical API keys. Jen, can you flip that rule?
jen: Done. `route.low_priority_to=cpu-fallback` applied at 2090123705.
eng-runtime: Quick revert plan: revert runtime image on a small canary subset to `runtime:stable-2026-04` and observe memory use. Initiating now.
pat: New nodes provisioning show intermittent `driver-init` timeouts but some succeeded. Node gpu-node-137 appeared healthy.
infra-shift: Provider opened EQ-5412 with emergency flag; partner approved +4 GPUs immediately at 2090123788 for short window. Permanent request submitted.
jen: Autoscaler allowed burst, scaling up 4 GPUs. Queue length starting to decline after new nodes registered.
lee: We're still seeing occasional Xid 79 on one older image. Those nodes will stay cordoned until drivers are reinstalled.
eng-runtime: Canary reverted to `runtime:stable-2026-04` at 2090123822. Memory growth on canary reduced dramatically. Plan full roll only after 30m soak. Filing follow-up ticket RIF-4320 to add cache memory caps.
pat: Draining gpu-node-113 hit a stuck PV; had to delete pod `async-batch-77` to complete drain.
cs-bot: Customer impact summary: dev/free: intermittent 502/503 and elevated latencies; standard: some increased latencies; enterprise: minimal impact. Logged under INC-2090123456.
jen: handoff note: I'm on call for next 20m, and then @lee takes primary at 2090124800. Current state:
- new nodes added: gpu-node-137, gpu-node-138, gpu-node-139 (+4 temporary)
- cordoned: gpu-node-109, gpu-node-113 (drivers under rework)
- autoscaler: burst policy allowed +4 GPUs short window
- runtime: canary reverted to stable image; plan full rollout after soak
- customer comms: sent at 2090123750
lee: taking over. I'll monitor for 1hr and publish a post-incident timeline. Next actions: request permanent quota increase (owner: infra-shift), rebuild driver images on cordoned nodes (owner: pat+eng-runtime), add autoscaler soft-fail behavior to prefer partial scale (owner: eng-platform).
eng-runtime: we'll prepare a hotfix to cap KV cache memory under continuous batching and add regression tests. Ticket RIF-4320 created.
infra-shift: Closing emergency allocation window in 6h; follow-up for permanent increase is EQ-5412-PR.
pat: Reinstalled drivers on gpu-node-109 and rebooted at 2090124440; no Xid observed in 15m. Uncordoned and rejoined.
jen: Queue back to normal levels, tail latency improving. Closing pager as mitigated but keeping thread open for handoff.
incident-bot: INC-2090123456 -> mitigated. Reopen if regressions.
lee: I'll assemble postmortem draft with timeline, impact, and action items. Expect initial draft in 24h. Thanks everyone. :pray:
